# Lavish Salon

> Hair salon at 100 E Pecan St, Suite C, in downtown Pflugerville. A quiet, cozy salon in downtown Pflugerville where Tina and Tuan do layered cuts, blondes, balayage and kids' cuts, and listen to what you actually want.

## Services
- Haircuts & layers: Layered cuts, long layers, curtain bangs and quick trims, done carefully and without the long sit.
- Kids & family cuts: Kind, patient stylists kids feel comfortable with. Some families have been coming to Tina and Tuan for years.
- Color & blondes: Full-head color, root touch-ups and bright blondes, from soft beige to icy platinum.
- Balayage & highlights: Hand-painted balayage and dimensional highlights that grow out soft.
- Vivid & fashion color: Silver, pastel and bold shades. One client went all-over light pink in a single session.
- Extensions, bridal & perms: Extensions, bridal and special-event hair, perms and chemical treatments. Call or text to talk it through first.

## About
Lavish Salon is a small, quiet salon at 100 E Pecan St, Suite C, in downtown Pflugerville. Look for the blue trim, the planter box full of flowers and the "lavish salon" sidewalk sign out front. Inside it's cozy: a greenery wall with rustic barn-wood panels and a gold "welcome to lavish salon" sign that clients love for an after photo of their fresh hair. There's usually a drink and a snack on offer while you sit. Tina is known for color, blondes, balayage and layered cuts, and some clients followed her here from her previous salon. Tuan cuts for the whole family. One mom says Tuan and Tina have been cutting her kids' hair for almost eight years.

## Frequently asked questions
- Q: Do I need an appointment?
  A: Booking ahead is the best way to get the time you want. Book online or call or text (512) 903-9931.
- Q: Do you cut kids' hair?
  A: Yes. Kids' cuts are a big part of what we do, and some families have been bringing their kids to Tuan and Tina for years.
- Q: Who are the stylists?
  A: Tina does a lot of the color, blondes, balayage and layered cuts, and Tuan cuts for the whole family. Ask for either one when you book.
- Q: Can I make a big color change in one visit?
  A: Often, yes. Tina has taken a client's whole head to light pink in a single session. Every head of hair is different, so we'll talk it through before we start.
- Q: Do you do extensions, bridal hair and perms?
  A: Yes. Call or text (512) 903-9931 to talk through what you have in mind before you book.
- Q: Where are you, and how can I pay?
  A: 100 E Pecan St, Suite C, Pflugerville, TX 78660, in downtown Pflugerville. Credit cards are accepted, there's free Wi-Fi, and the salon is wheelchair accessible.
